games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Complete this past simple sentence: “She ______ tired after the long party.”
rounds.answer: felt
rounds.explanation: Feel is irregular, so its past simple form is felt rather than feeled.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence gives advice using a modal verb?
choices: You should be gentle with the puppy.
The wind was fierce last night.
rounds.answer: You should be gentle with the puppy.
rounds.explanation: Should is the modal verb. The first option is an imperative, the third is a question, and the fourth is past simple.

rounds.prompt: Which question about a life experience is written correctly?
choices: Did you ever have felt proud?
rounds.answer: Have you ever felt proud?
rounds.explanation: A present perfect question puts have before the subject, then ever, then the past participle felt.

rounds.answer: She felt nervous because her big spelling test was the very next day.
rounds.explanation: Review the unit text evidence: She felt nervous because her big spelling test was the very next day.

rounds.prompt: Which part did Amal play in the school play, and why did it matter to her?

rounds.answer: She played the kind queen who helps people in need, and it was her first ever school play.
rounds.explanation: Review the unit text evidence: She played the kind queen who helps people in need, and it was her first ever school play.

rounds.prompt: What made Maya feel proud when she went to the fair last year?

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence shows selfish behaviour?
choices: Sami gave half of his sandwich away.
Maya held the classroom door open for her teacher.
Amal listened while the new girl spoke.
A child kept every paintbrush and shared none.
rounds.answer: A child kept every paintbrush and shared none.
rounds.explanation: Keeping everything for yourself is selfish. The other three sentences show generous, polite and gentle behaviour.

rounds.prompt: Complete this life-experience sentence: “I ______ never tried mango juice.”
rounds.answer: have
rounds.explanation: The subject is I, so the present perfect uses have with the past participle tried.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence describes a plan that is already arranged for tomorrow?
choices: We are visiting the fair tomorrow.
We visit the fair every single year.
We have visited the fair twice.
rounds.answer: We are visiting the fair tomorrow.
rounds.explanation: The present continuous plus a future time word signals an arranged plan, not a habit or a finished action.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: Which word means feeling worried or a little afraid about something that might happen?
rounds.answer: nervous
rounds.explanation: Nervous names that worried feeling. Attract is an action, a dishwasher is a machine, and frequent describes how often something happens.

rounds.prompt: Amal shook and could not sit still before her spelling test. Which word describes her best?
rounds.answer: anxious
rounds.explanation: Anxious describes a very worried feeling. Generous, humorous and polite all describe how a person behaves towards others.

rounds.prompt: What does the word generous mean?
choices: Happy to share or give to others
Quiet and afraid to talk to people
rounds.answer: Happy to share or give to others
rounds.explanation: The other three options are the meanings of evil, frequent and shy.
